summary.intent: Execute Phase 50 (IPFS/IPNS Data-Integrity Fixes) of the CipherBox milestone using wave-based parallel worktree execution across 5 plans, with Wave 1 running 4 plans concurrently and Wave 2 following after.
summary.outcome: All four Wave 1 plans (50-01, 50-02, 50-03, 50-05) completed with TDD RED→GREEN cycles, but the merge phase stalled due to worktree-generated file leakage into the orchestrator working tree and a silent mid-commit failure from the pre-commit hook. The session ended while manually recovering the 50-05 merge commit.

repo: Worktrees share the repo's workspace node_modules root, so running `pnpm api:generate` (orval) inside a worktree leaks 131+ generated api-client files and modified sdk/client.ts into the orchestrator's main working tree
init.manager mis-parses the dependency string 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' as a phantom phase '1.1', causing recommended_actions to show empty even when the real dep (Phase 49) is complete
Husky auto-generates untracked `.husky/_/` hook stubs inside worktrees whenever npm/pnpm install or generate scripts run, blocking cleanup-wave merge

The pre-commit hook runs check-api-client.sh + pnpm lint-staged (eslint --fix + prettier) over ~131 generated api-client files — slow enough to silently stall the cleanup-wave merge helper, leaving orphaned MERGE_HEAD state
Post-commit/post-rewrite hooks (or merge hooks) triggered by the first two worktree merges re-ran api-client generation into the main working tree, dirtying it and blocking subsequent merges
IN-04 IpfsModule → VaultModule circular import is a known structural issue; extraction is deferred and documented with explicit cycle-reason comments in all three module files

code.finding: Refcount guard added here for WR-03: skip physical unpin in drain when CID is actively re-pinned, preventing double-free during concurrent re-pin-during-drain races
collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync added (async on-demand fetch+decrypt for unloaded folders) replacing synchronous collectSubtreeIpnsNames; 4 deletion call-sites updated to await the new async form

WR-02 fix: upload compensation catch now calls ipfsProvider.unpinFile(result.cid) directly to physically remove the Kubo pin even when no pinned_cids row exists — guardedUnpin is intentionally bypassed here

workflow: cleanup-wave can silently leave MERGE_HEAD if the pre-commit hook stalls or times out mid-commit; recovery path is: detect MERGE_HEAD, verify no unmerged paths with `git ls-files -u`, then manually run `git commit` with a generous timeout

Before discarding 'leaked' working-tree files from worktree side-effects, verify they are byte-identical to the worktree branch's committed versions using git rev-parse / diff — they almost always are and can be safely restored with git checkout
Wave manifests should track which worktrees are already merged so re-runs of cleanup-wave don't attempt to re-process removed worktrees

friction: init.manager phantom-phase mis-parse: 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' parsed as phase '1.1', suppressing all recommended_actions despite Phase 50 being fully planned and ready
Worktree orval/pnpm api:generate leaked 131 api-client files and sdk/client.ts into the orchestrator's main working tree after Wave 1 completed, blocking the cleanup-wave merge for 50-05 and 50-03
Husky `.husky/_/` stubs generated as untracked files in the 50-05 worktree, causing cleanup-wave to report the worktree as dirty and refuse to merge it
cleanup-wave merge helper silently failed mid-commit for 50-05 (no error output, no exit code surface), leaving MERGE_HEAD orphaned and requiring manual diagnosis and recovery
After merging 50-01 and 50-02, the orchestrator working tree became dirty with api-client regeneration (131 files), blocking all subsequent cleanup-wave invocations
open_items: Wave 2 (plan 50-04, depends on 50-01 + 50-02) not yet dispatched — session ended during merge recovery; must dispatch 50-04 once merge is complete
50-05 merge commit in progress at session end — pre-commit hook (lint-staged over 131 files) still running; needs to complete before 50-03 can merge
IN-04 circular import (IpfsModule → VaultModule) accepted with comments but module extraction explicitly deferred to a future phase
init.manager dep-string parser should handle 'Phase N (description)' format without mis-parsing the description as a version number
cleanup-wave helper should surface pre-commit hook output/exit code rather than silently failing and leaving MERGE_HEAD state
